name: SSD Ore no Gakkou Seikatsu wa Kanojo ni Shihai Sarete Iru
original_name: SSD オレの学校生活は彼女に支配されている
source:
The male protagonist enrolls at a former all-girl's school and is pushed around by his female classmates.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170715122632/http://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_111340/]DMM[/url]]
translation:
男主角就读于一所前女子学校，并受到女同学的欺凌。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170715122632/http://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_111340/]DMM[/url]]
